releaseNotes: feat: Enhance code editor with gutter and bracket matching functionality
changelog: Added a gutter to the code editor for line numbering and active line highlighting.
Implemented synchronization of gutter lines with the number of lines in the editor.
Introduced functions to calculate cursor line information and manage bracket matching.
Enhanced the highlighting logic to include bracket matching and error handling for mismatched brackets.
Updated the UI to reflect changes in the gutter and editor layout.
Improved performance by caching highlighted code and reducing unnecessary re-renders.
Added unit tests for bracket scanning and matching functionality.
